name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinetry?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinetry is built entirely from scratch to your exact specifications, offering unlimited choices in materials, finishes, dimensions, and design details to fit any space perfectly. Semi-custom cabinetry offers more options than stock cabinets but is still based on a range of pre-defined sizes and styles, allowing for some modifications like depth changes or specific finishes. Custom cabinetry provides the ultimate personalization and fit, while semi-custom offers a balance between customization and cost-effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinetry is built to exact specifications for a perfect fit and unlimited design. Semi-custom offers more options than stock but uses pre-defined sizes and styles.
